core_problem_solved: To provide a Java-based template engine that strictly enforces the separation of model (business logic) and view (presentation), ensuring templates themselves remain free of complex logic.
key_features: A simple template language with strict rules against complex logic (e.g., no arithmetic, no arbitrary method calls)
Group-based template organization and template inheritance
Strong focus on ensuring a clean Model-View-Controller (MVC) separation
era_and_niche: A specialized template engine created by the author of ANTLR, appealing to developers who prioritize a pure model-view separation. It is particularly well-suited for generating highly structured text formats like source code or configuration files.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** and is actively maintained, but it serves a specific philosophical niche. The broader Java community has largely standardized on more flexible template engines like **Thymeleaf** (for web applications) and **FreeMarker** (for general use), which allow more logic and convenience within the templates themselves.
